propositions: A new advisory 1-TURN plan-review criterion `ac-process-gate` must be added to flag acceptance criteria whose completion predicate is a generic, ticket-agnostic process/tooling gate (children-closed, tests pass, CI passes, plan-review passes, etc.) that CI or rebar enforces for every ticket regardless of subject.

The criterion must discriminate between generic mechanical gates (which should fire a finding) and ticket-specific deliverable ACs (which should pass), using the litmus: would this exact AC read and be satisfied identically on an arbitrary unrelated ticket?

The criterion must be registered in `registry.CANONICAL_LLM` but absent from `CODEBASE_GROUNDED` and `AGENT_TIER`, routed with `advisory` posture and `ac-text-quality` facet at `container` and `leaf` scope.

A rubric prompt, routing entry, guide section, and bounded-sanity eval spec must be implemented following the established 1-TURN non-code-grounded criterion pattern, with at least 2 fire cases (process-gate ACs) and 2 no-fire cases (deliverable ACs).
